artisans.name: Engr. Ibrahim Danladi
artisans.bio: Certified master electrician with 9 years field experience in Gombe. Specializing in solar inverter installations, resolving tricky earthing problems, and safe residential conduit wiring.
artisans.workshopAddress: Shop 14, Near Pantami Stadium Main Gate, Pantami, Gombe
artisans.pricingNote: Inspection fee is deductible from total project cost upon hiring.

verification.associationName: Licensed Electrical Contractors Association of Nigeria (LECAN), Gombe Branch

portfolio.title: 5kVA Pure Sine Wave Solar System in Tumfure
portfolio.description: Complete hybrid solar installation featuring 8 monoline solar panels, 48V Lithium battery bank, and automated changeover for a new 4-bedroom bungalow.

portfolio.title: Industrial DB Panel Rewiring
portfolio.description: Overhauled an overloaded distribution panel for a commercial clinic in Bolari, separating heavy medical loads with individual RCBO breakers.

reviews.comment: I just rented a house in Tumfure coming from Abuja and had zero electricity contacts. Engr. Ibrahim arrived within 30 minutes, identified the dead neutral line, and fixed my inverter. Extremely polite and honest!
Very professional work. He cleanly labelled all circuit breakers in my home. He speaks fluent English and Hausa which made communication smooth.

artisans.name: Adebayo "Baba" Oladipo
artisans.bio: Seasoned plumber with over 12 years of hands-on experience in Gombe. Master of PPR heat-fusion piping, pressure pumps, and fixing stubborn underground pipeline leaks without unnecessary destruction.
artisans.workshopAddress: Opposite Central Mosque Line, Jeka Da Fari, Gombe
artisans.pricingNote: Transparent pricing. Client inspects plumbing materials before installation.

verification.associationName: Gombe State Association of Professional Plumbers

portfolio.title: Modern Under-Sink & Water Manifold Installation
portfolio.description: Installed brass shut-off valves, copper adapter lines and dual kitchen basin drains with zero leaks in Federal Low Cost estate.

reviews.comment: Our water tank was overflowing and burning the pumping machine sensor. Adebayo fixed the float switch and redid the overflow line within 2 hours.

artisans.name: Mallam Musa Haruna
artisans.bio: Dedicated wood craftsman building durable, termite-treated furniture, security doors, and bespoke wardrobes. Combines traditional northern joinery with modern finishes.
artisans.workshopAddress: Behind College of Nursing Junction, Tumfure Layout, Gombe
artisans.pricingNote: Free material estimate consultation provided for full home furniture orders.

verification.associationName: National Union of Furniture & Woodworkers, Gombe

portfolio.title: Custom Hardwood Dining & Work Tables
portfolio.description: Crafted 6-seater solid mahogany dining set with natural varnish for a visitor newly settled in Gombe.

reviews.comment: Mallam Musa made sturdy solid wood doors for my rented house and re-hinged all broken kitchen drawers. Honest craftsman right here in Tumfure.

artisans.name: Fatima Aliyu
artisans.bio: Young dynamic female artisan breaking boundaries in interior decoration and decorative painting. Passionate about transforming drab rental apartments into warm, modern spaces.
artisans.workshopAddress: Behind Gombe State Library, Bolari, Gombe
artisans.pricingNote: Free color combination advice included with every project.

portfolio.title: Modern Wall Screeding & Soft Beige Painting
portfolio.description: Complete 3-bedroom apartment screeding and premium matt paint job with moisture seal against harmattan dust in Federal Low Cost.

reviews.comment: Fatima is meticulous. No paint splatters on my tiles or switches, and she finished ahead of schedule. Highly recommended to anyone renting a new house.

artisans.name: Salisu Tanko
artisans.bio: Rapid-response generator specialist. Serving homes, clinics, and businesses across Gombe with 24/7 troubleshooting for all generator brands.
artisans.workshopAddress: Opposite State Water Board Quarters, Federal Low Cost, Gombe
artisans.pricingNote: Immediate emergency visits available within 45 minutes.

portfolio.title: Complete Overhaul of 15kVA Diesel Generator
portfolio.description: Replaced piston rings, overhauled fuel injection pump, and balanced alternator voltage for uninterrupted power.

reviews.comment: My small generator refused to start late at night. Called Salisu through SkillLink, he guided me on phone first, then came early morning and fixed the blocked carburetor. Fair pricing!

reviews.comment: Bello built our compound back-gate and window burglary protectors. Very heavy gauge iron, neat joints, and clean primer coat.

artisans.name: Yakubu Sani
artisans.bio: Specialist in keeping northern homes cool. Expert diagnostics on inverter air conditioners, energy-saving cooling systems, and commercial cold rooms.
artisans.pricingNote: Includes pressure manifold vacuum test before refrigerant refilling.

reviews.comment: With the Gombe heat, moving into our house was tough until Yakubu installed our bedroom AC cleanly. No messy pipes on the wall!

reviews.comment: Halima tailored all curtains for our new home in record time. Every stitch is aligned, and she brought fabric samples directly to our living room.
